name: Arjun Kapoor
review: I topped up my prepaid number on 12th and saw the amount got deducted two times. Can you please refund the extra Rs.100? Not a big emergency, just when you get a chance. Thanks!

name: Sneha Mehta
review: Hey bhai, my accout got locked after I entered wrong password a few times. I tried resetting it but the app still says it's locked. Can you please unlok it soon? I need to check my data usage.

name: Karan Rao
review: Hey, my SMS is not sending or receiving since this morning. I rebooted the phone, checked network bars and even tried SIM swap, but still nothing. It's messing up my work calls and messages, please fix it quickly!

name: Manoj Iyer
review: Hi, can you tell me what recharge packs are available for my plan? I want to know if there are any combo offers or data add‑ons. Please send details. Thanks.

name: Arjun Kapoor
review: Sir, I recently got a new SIM and tried to transfer my old number to it, but the system still shows the ownership under my previous SIM. I called support and was told it would be fixed in 48 hrs, but nothing has changed yet. Please sort this out soon.

name: Suresh Mehta
review: Hello, my internet has been down for the past 4 days in the Rajaji Nagar area. I keep getting 'no signal' on my phone and the router shows no connectivity. This is affecting my work, please fix it ASAP!

name: Ananya Chauhan
review: I cancelled my broadband plan about a week ago and was told the refund would be done in 5 working days. It's now 10 days and still nothing has come through. Please check the status and process the refund soon, this delay is really inconvenient.

name: Rahul Joshi
review: I made the payment for my bill on 5th July but it still shows as unpaid in the app. Could you please update it when you get a chance? Thanks!
